config.selection: Each qualifying saved line and side per event/player/book/reference/method

notes: Retrospective replay of saved prices, not placed bets. The latest daily archive for each selection is used; quote capture times and fills are not verified.

Analysis and Devig Results use the same offers: each qualifying saved line and side per event/player/book/reference/method, with repeated snapshots deduplicated before grading. EV has no upper limit by default.
Flat 1u risk per settled selection. ROI = net units / (wins + losses + pushes). Pending and ungraded selections are excluded, never counted as losses.

Missing opposite reference odds use the site's 7% vig assumption, including its longshot guard and one-sided-under complement. A betting book and its shared book group cannot contribute to their own reference estimate. Blends require every constituent.
EV and profit include configured exchange fees. Historical fees and executions are not verified. There is no minimum saved liquidity by default, matching Analysis.
Best available selects one book by net payout for each line/side, using the Analysis best-book pool. All books counts individual offers and excludes the Best available aggregate.
Book rankings use each book's qualifying selections, which can differ. These are not comparisons of identical matched bets.
ATGS means scoring at least one goal. No-goal selections and alternate goal totals are reported as separate markets.
Odds-band and strategy leaders describe this period. Small samples and searching many combinations can produce large, unstable ROI.
